about: Pilot of the combination-experiment schema (crawler/extractor.py, 2026-11-27): records filled by hand from cached paper text, as a worker session would, then run through the quote verifier. Not merged into the graph. 33493520 is a negative example: its 'synergistically' is about peptide mutations.

38831315.magnitude: increase of 2.9 ± 0.8% vs 30.6 ± 4.3% with control siRNA
38831315.evidence_quote: IL-24 at 150 ng/ml enhanced T-currents in either IL-20R1-siRNA- or its negative control (NC-siRNA)-treated TG neurons (Fig. 2E), while knockdown of IL-22R1 completely abolished the IL-24–induced T-current response (increase of 2.9 ± 0.8%; Fig. 2F)
when TG neurons were pretreated with the small-molecule Lyn inhibitor bafetinib (1 µM), the IL-24-induced increase in T-currents was completely abolished (increase of 2.3 ± 1.7%; Fig. 3F)
IL-24 at 150 ng/ml enhanced T-currents in NC-siRNA-treated TG neurons (Fig. 3H), while knockdown of Lyn completely abolished the IL-24–induced T-current response (increase of 3.5 ± 1.2%; Fig. 3H)
